entries.4d8b68e0f0bfb064: This is the business in which the company wholesales car products, motorcycle products and others to sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies and group companies, and also sells at retail through sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies and Web sites. Joyful Co., Ltd. manufactures and wholesales car products, motorcycle products and others. Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥165,486 million (111.6% of the same period of the previous year, an increase of ¥17,199 million), which is among the larger reportable segments. Segment profit (a figure based on operating profit in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥13,680 million (97.3% of the same period, a decrease of ¥376 million). In net sales by product category (consolidated total), tires and wheels were the largest at ¥52,321 million (30.5% of the total), and labor charges were ¥25,266 million (14.8%). Labor charges have been shown separately from the fiscal year ended March 2026 because their amount became more significant. The number of stores as of the end of March 2026 was 936 in total: 765 Yellow Hat stores, 65 2Rinkan stores, 78 Bike-kan stores (including Kawasaki Plaza) and 28 Y's Road stores. In addition, there are 10 vehicle inspection centers, 12 coin-operated car washes and 101 Niconico Rent-a-Car locations.

In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥5,793 million (100.2% year on year, an increase of ¥13 million), and segment profit (based on operating profit in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥1,406 million (100.9% year on year, an increase of ¥12 million).
entries.96d06ea43cc9669b: Gross profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥74,477 million (110.5% of the prior year, up ¥7,085 million), selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥59,389 million (114.3%, up ¥7,449 million), and operating income was ¥15,087 million (97.6%, down ¥363 million). The company explains the increase in selling, general and administrative expenses as due to an increase in subsidiary stores; higher depreciation from the start of operations at Shin-Tōhoku Butsuryū and the renewal of equipment at existing stores; higher personnel, store operating and logistics costs; higher goodwill amortization from making Waizu Rōdo Yellow Hat a subsidiary; and one-time costs such as relocation and renovation of logistics bases and the development of system environments. Ordinary profit was ¥16,582 million (98.5%, down ¥256 million), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥11,968 million (106.3%, up ¥707 million); the company explains that the increase in net income was due to, among other things, recording a gain on sale of investment securities. Segment profit (figures based on operating income in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥13,680 million for the car and motorcycle accessories and other sales business (97.3%) and ¥1,406 million for the rental real estate business (100.9%).
